_doc: Per-table import hints for import-sheet.py. Keys are Google Sheets *table names* (not sheet titles). Formula-only columns are dropped automatically; list one under keep_columns to keep it.

table_notes.Maps_metadata: Map order and size. Num Levels is derived from LevelData (not exported); Num Required Levels = levels to clear before the next map unlocks.
table_notes.HeartConfig: Meta lives (energy). cooldown is seconds; refillCost is Gem (hard currency).
table_notes.InGameHeartConfig: Save Me continues ('in-game hearts'). lostReasonFlags bitmask: bit0 time-out, bit1 wrong order, bit2 burned. saveMeCost is Gem, saveMeAdd = hearts granted per purchase.
table_notes.RewardConfig: Level-win reward by DifficultyTag (Normal/Hard/Super Hard). bonusMuls are % multipliers for the rewarded-ad bonus; bonus is used when the array is empty. lvShowBonusAds = first level the bonus-ad offer shows.
table_notes.MechanicFeatures: Feature flags. dirtyStack is the per-cell dirty stack cap.
table_notes.ServeSlots: Serve-slot window (min..max). delayTriggerSaveMe in seconds after the loss.
table_notes.ProgressScenario: Player is sent to the Home (restaurant) scene at firstLvOutHome and every intervalOutHome levels after.
table_notes.SpeedUpFeature: x`speed` cooking boost: freeMinutes free, activateMinutes per activation, price in Gem or a rewarded ad.
table_notes.Emotion: Customer mood from remaining patience: Threshold is the minimum fraction of wait time left; Price Remain is the payout fraction; Coin Spawn is soft coins dropped on serve.
table_notes.ItemValue: Gem price of every sellable/rewardable item and its USD value (1 Gem = $0.001). saveme_1..4 are the 1st/2nd/3rd/4th+ Save Me purchase in one level -- incremental pricing.
table_notes.IAPShop: IAP catalog: price in USD and what the pack grants. The sheet's margin math (Total Value / Gain / Sale) and the concat `data` string are derived and not exported.
table_notes.Reward7Days: Daily login rewards -- empty in the sheet, feature not authored yet.
table_notes.JourneyMilestone: Level-milestone rewards. soft = Coin, hard = Gem.
table_notes.Booster: Booster definitions. Enable 0 = cut from the game. Price is looked up from ItemValue (derived, not exported here).
table_notes.SaveMe: Save Me variants by loss reason. Prices live in ItemValue saveme_1..4 (1st/2nd/3rd/4th+ purchase in one level); the sheet's Price column is a lookup and is not exported.
table_notes.HomeBuilding: Restaurant decoration parts per map, priced in Coin (soft). Map 3 rows are placeholders (no ids/titles yet).
table_notes.Customers: Named customer cast. Type Normal / Shipper (staff) / Boss. FileID is a Google Drive image id.
table_notes.DataTracking: Analytics event contract (GA4 + AppsFlyer). Category/Event are forward-filled from the sheet's merged layout.
table_notes.LevelData: Per-level design rows (MapLevelProgress). Large; level design is out of scope for pipeline work -- query with --where Map=1 rather than dumping it.
table_notes.GraphLookupData: Id-table index per map (ingredient/group/composite/tool/dirty). Mostly empty price/speed/stack overrides.
table_notes.ads_network_config: Ad mediation per format: value indexes AdsMediation (0 None, 1 Max, 2 Admob).
table_notes.ads_inter_config: Interstitial rules: passLvRq = first level interstitials show; capTime* in seconds.
